# prime-iftalabel

prime-rs: IftaLabel component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/iftalabel) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-iftalabel)

IftaLabel — port of `p-iftalabel` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Renders `<span class="p-iftalabel">` with a nested field and `<label>`; the position of the label above the value and the paddings of the
field are set by the theme CSS. The `/* For PrimeNG */` block (`.ng-invalid.ng-dirty`) does not apply to this markup: the color of an
invalid value comes from the base rule `:has(.p-invalid) label`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_iftalabel::IftaLabel;

let html = view! { <IftaLabel><input class="p-inputtext" id="u" /><label for="u">"Name"</label></IftaLabel> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains(r#"class="p-iftalabel""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-iftalabel = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["iftalabel"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
